# EXAMPLE — README rules for this repository

> This file is an example shipped with `miyako/4d-template`. Delete it, or replace it with a real
> repository-specific rule set, in every repository created from the template.

- Keep the sections of `README.md` in this order: overview, requirements, getting started, project structure,
  references, license.
- Write for developers who clone the repository. Never add Copilot model, mode, token or session content.
- Link to 4D documentation with `https://developer.4d.com/docs/...` URLs, not to copies in this repository.
- For 4D coding conventions, use the skills in `.agents/skills/` (start with `.agents/AGENTS.md`); do not
  restate them here.
